description: Create a chronologically organized evidence timeline document for a small claims court case. Open the document at /home/ga/Documents/TextDocuments/evidence_raw.docx which contains unsorted evidence entries. Create a new document titled 'Evidence Timeline - Silva v. Martinez Home Repair Dispute' with case number '2024-SC-8847'. Organize the 8 evidence entries into a chronological table with columns: Date (MM/DD/YYYY format), Event Description, and Evidence Reference. Add a summary section showing Total Paid ($3,500), Cost to Complete ($2,800), and Amount Claimed ($3,500). Save as 'SmallClaims_Evidence_Timeline.docx' in /home/ga/Documents/TextDocuments/.
